modules.name: Whole-System Money Flow
modules.now: Money Engine, Household, Human/Community, Government procurement, and Transition guardrails exist as separate working models.
modules.problem: Without a master flow, dollars can jump between engines without explained leakage, tax, transfer, or reinvestment.
modules.future_state: A dollar can be traced through the system without an unexplained jump.
modules.mechanism: Master flow: External income/production → enterprise → compensation → household → consumption/saving/ownership → capital formation → public revenue/public ownership where applicable → investment → greater productive capability → new external income. Mark leakage, taxation, transfers, reinvestment, public return. Join ME River/Leakage, HP Funnel, GO Public Dollar Chain, TR Current-State Ledger.
modules.money_flow: The module IS the money-flow map — architecture only; no new COUNTABLE numbers.
modules.ownership: Flow identifies who holds claims at each node without forcing one ownership form.
modules.household_effect: Household is a required node — not an optional afterthought.
modules.government_role: Tax/transfer/public ownership/procurement nodes are explicit and role-separated (GO roles).
modules.market_role: Enterprise and capital formation remain primary private discovery mechanisms under anti-extraction rules.
modules.transition: Flow respects Dependency Rule — legacy revenue nodes remain until Replacement-ready.
modules.risks: Fake precision; treating potential engines as present cash.
modules.measurement: Orphan-flow register empty at architectural level; Stage 3 fills empirics.

modules.name: Ownership & Surplus Distribution
modules.now: Ownership pathways exist across Money, Human, Household, and Government Investor/Owner roles.
modules.problem: Without an integration matrix, ownership forms can be asserted without identifying control, risk, and surplus destinations.
modules.future_state: Across the system: Who owns? → Who controls? → Who bears risk? → Who receives surplus? → Where is surplus reinvested? — with identifiable homes for private, worker, cooperative, household, community, and justified public ownership.
modules.mechanism: Integration matrix (not a mandate for public or local ownership of everything). Homes: ME-04 ownership ladder, HC-05 enterprise pipeline, HP surplus→assets, GO Investor/Owner vs Referee conflict rule, ME-08 retention.
modules.money_flow: Surplus destinations determine whether capital retains in Arkansas or leaks.
modules.ownership: Matrix enumerates forms; public ownership only where specifically justified and role-separated.
modules.household_effect: Household ownership is a first-class destination of surplus — not residual charity.
modules.government_role: Rulemaker/Referee of ownership rules; Investor/Owner only under conflict discipline.
modules.market_role: Private and worker/co-op ownership compete under fair rules.
modules.transition: Ownership transfers follow TR states; no abolish-today of existing titles.
modules.risks: Ideology capture; ignoring risk-bearing; blending Regulator and Owner.

modules.name: Household Prosperity Transmission
modules.now: Household Prosperity Engine declares the unit of success; other engines reference it unevenly.
modules.problem: Economic proposals can orphan the household — claiming system success without surplus/security/time path.
modules.future_state: Conceptual proof that reforms transmit: System reform → productivity/value → income/cost/security/time → Prosperity Surplus → assets → household wealth → intergenerational capital.
modules.mechanism: Join HP Surplus architecture, Capability Ladder, Money Engine, GO Public Dollar outcomes, TR Intergenerational Ledger. Flag Stage 3 any major proposal lacking household or necessary public-good path — do not invent effects.
modules.money_flow: Transmission requires cost and income lines on surplus panel — not GDP theater.
modules.ownership: Assets and net wealth are required endpoints of successful transmission.
modules.household_effect: This module is the household-effect integrity test for the whole system.
modules.government_role: Measure household outcomes (GO-10); refuse vanity KPIs.
modules.market_role: Markets judged partly by household transmission, not only firm profit.
modules.transition: Early periods may improve measurement before surplus dollars appear — still must show the path.
modules.risks: Invented household gains; public-good excuses that never touch households.
modules.measurement: Orphan-proposal register for Stage 3; surplus panel architecture live.

modules.name: Political-Economic Power Balance
modules.lock: Power Loop / Capture Loop / Prosperity Cycle
modules.now: Prosperity Cycle (capability→production→money→household→capability) and Power/Capture Loops exist as separate working architectures.
modules.problem: Wealth and productive scale can purchase political power unless the cycles are joined with circuit breakers.
modules.future_state: Answer: people accumulate wealth and enterprises scale productively without economic power purchasing the political system — via circulating political power, Capture Circuit Breakers, and distributed ownership.
modules.mechanism: Join Prosperity Cycle with Power Loop and Capture Loop + eight breaker categories (GO-08). No campaign-finance, antitrust, or constitutional research reopening. CX-M21-02 remains Stage 4 for legal reach.
modules.money_flow: Political money and preferential contracts are Capture Loop arrows interrupted by GO-06/GO-08.
modules.ownership: Distributed ownership reduces both economic and political chokepoints.
modules.household_effect: Households retain political independence when economic power is not reconcentrated into rule purchase.
modules.government_role: Power circulates back to people; government is constrained Rulemaker/Referee, not capture prize.
modules.market_role: Scale allowed; preferential political purchase of rules forbidden.
modules.transition: Anti-capture breakers install early (Years 1–2) before large ownership transitions.
modules.risks: Reopening legal research sprawl; breaker theater without enforcement capacity.
modules.measurement: Breaker coverage on Capture arrows; trust/capture proxies later.

modules.name: Arkansas Transition Dependency Network
modules.now: Engines are complete at first-pass; Transition Map periods and Dependency Rule exist.
modules.problem: Without placing system families in time with dependencies, sequencing can be impossible or abolish-today.
modules.future_state: Every major system family placed in NOW → Years 1–2 → 3–5 → 6–10 → Generation 1 → Generation 2 with dependency relationships identified — placement, not detailed scheduling.
modules.mechanism: Network join: Money/ownership engines → capacity then prove/scale; Human capability → early capacity; Government OS measurement/anti-capture → Years 1–2; Household surplus measurement → continuous; Replacement of tax bases → only after Replacement-ready. Expose impossible sequencing as Stage 3 flags.
modules.money_flow: Fiscal guardrails apply at every period node.
modules.ownership: Ownership transitions follow TR states on the network.
modules.household_effect: No period may schedule household cliffs before bridges.
modules.government_role: Control Board operates the network decisions.
modules.market_role: Markets absorb phased placement — not shock sequencing.
modules.transition: This module IS the time integration of all engines.
modules.risks: Fake detailed Gantt charts; hidden impossible edges.
modules.measurement: Dependency edges documented; impossible-edge register for Stage 3.
modules.deferred_validation: Full prerequisite graph per replacement — Stage 3

modules.name: Measurement & Correction Operating System
modules.now: Measurement ideas exist across Build Progress, GO-10, HP surplus, HC pentagon, TR Control Board, and correction vocabulary.
modules.problem: Without one feedback OS, the system assumes designers are always right.
modules.future_state: Constitutional Capitalism learns: Baseline → Action → Output → Outcome → Household Effect → Geographic Effect → Public Return → Resilience → Compare → KEEP / REFORM / PHASE OUT / ELIMINATE / NEW.
modules.mechanism: Join GO-10, TR-08, HP-10, HC community capitals, Public Dollar Chain, resilience categories. Philosophical closure: feedback over infallibility.
modules.money_flow: Public return and household effect are required feedback nodes — not optional PR.
modules.ownership: Measuring sticks are public trusts (anti-capture of metrics).
modules.household_effect: Household Effect is a mandatory feedback stage.
modules.government_role: Provider of open feedback systems; Referee against cooked metrics.
modules.transition: Feedback begins in Years 1–2; does not wait for maturity.
modules.risks: Vanity KPIs; metric capture; inability to EXIT.
modules.measurement: Feedback loop completeness; decision distribution over time.
